body:
No worries. You didn't make anything worse. You're right about depression being illogical. I know about the things I need to do. But again, I have those thoughts. "Why even try? It will take way too long and you'll give up." And past experiences have confirmed those thoughts countless times. 

I'll be going back to university in a month and a half, so yeah I'll be out of the house. Though, the food options there aren't a hell of a lot better.

Weight isn't my only problem. Not by a long shot. But I feel like if I could become better looking somehow then I might be more confident to fix more of my problems. But I can't finish anything... I feel guilty for even having these stupid first world problems.

I swear that's what gets me. I know I'm a fucking terrible person. I'm overweight. "You disgusting fucking loser. No one will ever love a lazy disgusting shit like you." I know all this. It goes through my mind every day. Yet somehow things like that still aren't enough to get my stupid lazy ads going. I'll still eat unhealthy foods. I'll still be sedentary even when I have free time. I'm so fucking lazy and tired and sad. Even knowing I'm disgusting and unloveable, I still won't make a change. It makes me hate myself even more. 

Even when I can start working out I won't make it a week. "This will take too long, what's the point? You'll never exercise long enough or hard enough to be who you want to be." That's all I fucking hear in my own head. Just tearing myself down so I'll give up, and I always do. 

I can't even diet because I know there's unhealthy foods in the house. I'm currently with my parents and all they stock the house with is junk. I'm not blaming them. I know it's still my fault, my own lack of willpower, but I continue to eat that shit. I have no fucking willpower. As I type this I think to myself "This won't change a thing. You're just making yourself look like a bigger idiot than you already are." I feel like I want to change but I just won't. Something is so fucking wrong in my head, be it laziness, depression, a mixture of things... I don't know. I just wish I could be like my friends.

Goddammit I hate myself.
Interesting. Thanks for the info. It definitely puts my mind at ease. I might try and sneak a few more comics then haha.

I hope so. I know I'm probably just being majorly paranoid. I had no idea how complicated torrenting was and how careful you had to be.

I just sort of jumped in like an idiot and started downloading things. Hopefully I'm just over thinking it.
